name: zgeometry_weiler_intersect2d
description: zGeometry_Weiler::Intersect2d classifies two XY segments and optionally appends a crossing record with the interpolated XYZ intersection point.
known_limits: Binary Ninja has documented x87 rendering limitations around the ClassifyIntersect2d callsite and the computed intersection Y store. Assembly is the accepted behavior evidence.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x468c40 validates the ClassifyIntersect2d call, output-kind dispatch table, GetAppendSpace allocation from xingBuffer, computed intersection X/Y stores, Z interpolation from the second edge, xingType writeback, outXing writeback, and disjoint no-allocation path.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies a crossing result with one appended xing at (5, 0, 5), xingType 5, and a disjoint result that leaves outXing null and the xing buffer count unchanged.
